pergunta: How many Prius has Evan owned?

focused_selection.text:
Session date: 1:47 pm on 18 May, 2023
[D1:1] Sam: Hey Evan, good to see you! What's new since we last met? Anything cool happening?
[D1:2] Evan: Hey Sam! Good to see you! Yeah, I just got back from a trip with my family in my new Prius.
[D1:3] Sam: Wow, not bad, what happened to the old one? Where'd you go, by the way?
[D1:4] Evan: My old prius broke down, decided to get it repaired and sell it. Glad you asked, we went to Rockies, check it out.
[D1:5] Sam: Wow! Looks amazing. When did you get to go there?
[...]
Session date: 3:55 pm on 6 June, 2023
[D3:6] Sam: Yeah, good idea! I'll give it a try.
[D3:7] Evan: Awesome, Sam! Let me know how it goes. Making small changes can really help you live a healthier life. Don't forget - every step matters!
[D3:8] Sam: Hey Evan, thanks! Appreciate it. I'll definitely keep you posted.
[D3:9] Evan: I'm here for you, Sam. Let's continue supporting each other on our health journeys. It's important to remember that progress takes time.
[D3:10] Sam: Yeah, you're right. It takes time, but I'm up for keep trying and making those tiny changes.
[D3:11] Evan: C'mon, keep it up! Every little bit counts, you'll get there!

Session date: 7:30 pm on 21 November, 2023
[D17:28] Evan: Thanks, Sam. If you need to talk, I'm here for you too.
Session date: 8:16 pm on 5 December, 2023
[D18:1] Evan: Hey Sam, good to hear from you. I've hit a bit of a snag - my new Prius, the one I just bought, broke down. It's a bit of a stressor since I rely on it for my active lifestyle and road trips. It's frustrating when new things go awry so soon.
[D18:2] Sam: Hey Evan, that's rough. Dealing with a new car breaking down is such a hassle, especially when it's your main mode of transport.
[D18:3] Evan: You're telling me. I was really counting on this new Prius to be reliable. It's always a challenge when you have to deal with unexpected issues like this. But, I guess it's just one of those things - even new cars can have problems.
[D18:4] Sam: It's tough when your plans get derailed by something like this. But hey, sometimes these setbacks lead to new opportunities.
[...]
Session date: 6:48 pm on 17 December, 2023
[D20:2] Sam: Hey Evan! Long time no see. I'm doing okay, been through a few bumps. How about you?
[D20:3] Evan: It's not easy for us right now, my son had an accident last Tuesday, he fell off his bike and it was rough. But he's doing better now. How are you dealing with all this?
[D20:4] Sam: Darn, sorry to hear that. Hope he's feeling better. Same here, it's been tough lately. After we talked, I started thinking about ways to cope with it, but it's been challenging.
[D20:5] Evan: Life can be hard sometimes. Do you have any hobbies or activities that make you happy?
[D20:6] Sam: I used to love hiking, but it's been a while since I had the chance to do it.
[D20:7] Evan: I remember you mentioning that! Hiking is indeed a great way to center oneself and be one with nature. We should definitely plan a hike soon!
[D20:8] Sam: Yeah, I'm struggling with my weight and it's affecting my confidence. I feel like I can't overcome all the challenges with my weight, I keep lacking motivation.

Session date: 4:20 pm on 15 August, 2023
[D7:16] Sam: Thanks, Evan. I really appreciate that. It means a lot.
Session date: 6:17 pm on 19 August, 2023
[D8:1] Sam: Hey Evan, some big news: I'm on a diet and living healthier! Been tough, but I'm determined.
[D8:2] Evan: Wow, Sam, that's great news! Making changes to live healthier can be challenging, how has it been going?
[D8:3] Sam: It's tough, but I'm sticking with it.
[D8:4] Evan: Nice work, Sam! Proud of you sticking to it. Have you noticed any positive changes?
[D8:5] Sam: Yes, there are many, such as more energy and less sluggishness after eating. This is really encouraging!
[D8:6] Evan: Wow, Sam, that's great to hear! Feeling more energized after meals is such a positive change. Keep up the good work! And speaking of healthy meals, do you have any favorite recipes you'd like to share?
[D8:7] Sam: Sure, I'm loving this recipe I found. It's a flavorful and healthy grilled chicken and veggie stir-fry. Wanna give it a go?
[D8:8] Evan: Mmm, looks yummy! Is the sauce a family secret? I'm always down to try new recipes!
[D8:9] Sam: Nah, it's just my homemade sauce. Want the recipe?
[D8:10] Evan: Yeah, I'd love to! Thanks for sharing the recipe.
[D8:11] Sam: Sure thing! Here's the recipe. Let me know how it went!

Session date: 7:30 pm on 21 November, 2023
[D17:4] Evan: That sucks, Sam. It's tough when our health holds us back. I believe in you – just taking small steps can help. Have you tried any new hobbies recently to take your mind off it?
[D17:5] Sam: Thanks, Evan. I haven't tried much new lately, but I did get this yesterday. It's been my go-to 'feel good' flick. So, you said you had a health scare - how're you now?
[D17:6] Evan: That movie sounds interesting! I'm doing well now. Doctors said everything is fine, but it taught me the value of life. Just trying to enjoy the moment.
[D17:7] Sam: That's awesome, Evan! Let's make it a habit to appreciate something each day. It really helps us enjoy life more. What do you think?
[D17:8] Evan: Sounds good, Sam! Let's take the time to appreciate the little things in life.
[D17:9] Sam: Thanks for always being there, Evan. It means a lot.
[D17:10] Evan: Sure, Sam. I'm here for you. We gotta stick together, especially now.
[D17:11] Sam: Yeah, Evan. Life can be tough sometimes, but having supportive people like you makes it way easier.
[D17:12] Evan: Yeah, Sam. Tough times are way easier with friends we can rely on. We've got each other!
[D17:13] Sam: Looks like you're having a blast! I was wondering, what do you do to stay fit and healthy?
[D17:14] Evan: That was wild! I stay in shape by hitting the gym and taking my car out for a spin. Gotta keep it up! How are you doing on your fitness goals, Sam?
[D17:15] Sam: Fitness goals have been hard to reach, but hey, that's life!

Session date: 11:00 am on 31 December, 2023
[D22:1] Sam: Hey Evan! I’m really getting into this healthier lifestyle—just took my friends on an epic hiking trip last Friday!
[D22:2] Evan: Hey Sam! That’s fantastic—nothing like a good hike to feel alive. We took the Prius for a long drive to the mountains last weekend. It was perfect until we got into a little scrape on the way back.
[D22:3] Sam: Oh no, were you guys okay after the accident?
[...]
[D22:7] Sam: True, it’s important to stay safe. Glad you can still enjoy the peaceful moments after something like that.
[D22:8] Evan: Definitely, nature brings peace and clarity - it's a great experience.
[D22:9] Sam: Nature can make everything else seem small and help us find peace inside. It reminds us of the bigger picture, you know?
[D22:10] Evan: For sure, and nature has been a great healer. Speaking of which, I’ve got to share some of these new healthy snacks I’ve been trying.
[D22:11] Sam: They look healthy and delicious! Perfect for after a hike or, I guess, post-accident recovery, huh?
[D22:12] Evan: Exactly! They’re packed with nutrients and really easy to make. You also need to try these cookies, they are awesome! I’ll send you the recipes.
[D22:13] Sam: Thanks, I’d appreciate that. It’s good to find new ways to stay healthy. Do you have any healthier snack ideas?
[D22:14] Evan: Yeah, I've been trying to eat healthier too. Check out this cool recipe I discovered for these energy balls.
[D22:15] Sam: Do you like them? I know they can be an acquired taste.
[D22:16] Evan: I enjoy the taste of these. They're energizing and a healthy way to satisfy your sweet tooth.
